text.headline: Timeline of Syria
text.text: Major events in the history of Syria.

events.headline: Early Civilizations
events.text: Ancient cities like Ebla and Mari flourish as trade and cultural centers.

events.headline: Roman Rule Begins
events.text: Pompey annexes Syria into the Roman Republic; Antioch becomes a major city.

events.headline: Muslim Conquest
events.text: Arab Muslim forces defeat the Byzantines at Yarmouk.

events.headline: Ottoman Rule
events.text: Syria becomes part of the Ottoman Empire for nearly four centuries.

events.headline: End of Ottoman Rule
events.text: Arab and Allied forces capture Damascus during WWI.

events.headline: French Mandate
events.text: The League of Nations grants France control over Syria and Lebanon.

events.headline: Rise of Hafez al-Assad
events.text: Hafez al-Assad seizes power, beginning Ba'ath Party rule.

events.headline: Bashar al-Assad Becomes President
events.text: Bashar al-Assad assumes leadership after his father’s death.

events.headline: Syrian Civil War
events.text: Protests escalate into a prolonged civil war.

events.headline: Reconstruction and Sanctions
events.text: Syria remains divided; reconstruction is hindered by sanctions and instability.
